title: Review Run Receipt (v1)
description: PR-level marker recording a review pass. Embedded in a PR issue comment as `<!-- review-run:v1 {json} -->` and posted/updated by scripts/reviews/run. Current-generation receipts bind the review to both the PR headRefOid and a normalized material-claim digest; historical receipts without claim_digest remain parseable but are not claim-current.

head.description: The PR headRefOid this review pass ran against.

claim_digest.description: SHA-256 of the normalized material PR claim/review index. Optional only for historical v1 receipts.
